entities.name: PMID:27501360
observations: Six-week speed-based recumbent cycling feasibility study in older adults; intervention n=14, control n=12; two 30-minute sessions weekly with ten 20-second fast-cadence intervals per session.
Significant group-by-time interaction (P<0.05) supported a 2-second Timed Up and Go improvement in the exercise group but not controls.

entities.name: Cycling improved TUG
observations: In a small controlled feasibility study of older adults (n=26 total), 6 weeks of high-speed recumbent cycling was associated with a 2-second TUG improvement versus no significant control improvement; group-time interaction P<0.05.
